requirement: The subsystem shall operate from 600 V to 850 V pack voltage.
acceptance: All required functions pass at 600, 800 and 850 V

requirement: The subsystem shall prevent unintended HV energization.
acceptance: No single monitored fault produces torque enable

requirement: The initial nominal precharge current shall not exceed 10 A.
acceptance: Peak current <=10 A at all specified nominal corners

requirement: The DC-link shall reach at least 90% of pack voltage within 0.35 s.
Torque enable shall remain false until both main contactors are confirmed closed and precharge is open.
acceptance: No torque-enable assertion in invalid state

requirement: The subsystem shall detect precharge open, short and timeout faults.
acceptance: Fault detected within 20 ms after diagnostic criterion

requirement: The subsystem shall detect welded main contactors during shutdown.
acceptance: Weld fault latched when command, auxiliary contact and voltage disagree

requirement: The DC-link shall discharge below 60 V within 30 s after shutdown.
acceptance: Vdc <60 V at 30 s worst case

requirement: HVIL open shall inhibit contactor closure and torque enable.
acceptance: Outputs remain safe for all HVIL open cases

requirement: Invalid isolation status shall inhibit HV activation.
acceptance: No precharge command while isolation invalid

requirement: Voltage sensing shall include range, correlation and rate plausibility diagnostics.
acceptance: Specified sensor bias/open/short faults are detected

requirement: All test evidence shall identify model version, parameter set and execution timestamp.
acceptance: Evidence record is complete and reproducible
